United States Department of the Interior BUREAU OF OUTDOOR RECREATION
SOUTH CENTRAL REGIONAL OFFICE PATIO PLAZA, 5000 MARBLE N.E., ROOM 211 ALBUQUERQUE, NEW MEXICO 87110
IN REPLY REFER TO: 3420 - Rio Grande Wild and Scenic River Study
Mr. Gordon A. Walhood Chief, Engineering Division U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District P.O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Walhood:
Thank you for your letter of March 16, 1976, concerning the Amistad Lake Project.
Our Rio Grande Wild and Scenic River study is the only planning effort in this region which is in the vicinity. The final environmental statement and study report will be released within a month and we will send you copies. During the interim the enclosed draft EIS may be of some help. Please call us if you have any questions.
Sincerely yours,
Rolland B. Handley Regional Director
Enclosure
cc: IB&WC, El Paso, Texas
